INDIA bloc leaders to meet virtually on election issues

Leaders of the INDIA bloc are scheduled to hold a virtual meeting on Thursday to discuss strategies concerning the Election Commission's actions related to electoral rolls. The agenda includes planning for protests against alleged 'vote chori' (vote theft) and finalizing details for a November 1 rally. The opposition has accused the Chief Election Commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar, of irregularities.
